rows.en:
{C:81930400}{C:81958296FC3400000000}Oh, I'll explain it myself!
Listen carefully!!

{C:81930100}{C:81958296FD3400000000}Y-yes!

{C:81930400}{C:81958296FE3400000000}There are several types of bombardment,
depending on their purpose.

{C:81958296FF3400000000}First, {C:819782830600}the main cannon targets the enemy ship.{C:819782830000}
You can use this when invading the enemy,
during the attack phase.


{x00}

rows.en:
{C:81930400}{C:81958296003500000000}Its effect is to {C:819782830600}deal damage directly
to the enemy ship{C:819782830000}.

{C:81958296013500000000}However, that only applies
when there are no enemy units
in the enemy's lane.

{C:81958296023500000000}If there are enemy units,
the damage for that lane
will go to those units instead.

{C:81958296033500000000}What's more,
the damage that hits units
is spread out,

{C:81958296043500000000}so it is
almost completely nullified.

{C:81958296053500000000}So, to ensure you deal damage,
you need to create a situation where it's difficult
for the enemy to deploy multiple units.


{x00}

rows.en:
{C:81930400}{C:81958296063500000000}Next is {C:819782830600}support bombardment.{C:819782830000}

{C:81958296073500000000}You can also use this during the attack phase to 
{C:819782830600}deal damage directly
to enemy units on the field{C:819782830000}.

{C:81958296083500000000}But even if this support bombardment
fails to hit a unit,
it won't deal damage to the ship.


{x00}

rows.en:
{C:81930400}{C:81958296093500000000}Finally, there's interception bombardment,
which attacks enemy units
when the enemy invades you.

{C:819582960A3500000000}Since interception bombardment can only
be used during the defense phase,
I'll explain it later.

{C:819582960B3500000000}All right, here I go.








{x00}

{C:81930400}{C:819582960D3500000000}Like support bombardment, interception bombardment can 
{C:819782830600}deal damage directly
to enemy units{C:819782830000}.

{C:81930100}{C:819582960E3500000000}Hmm...

{C:81930400}{C:819582960F3500000000}You don't understand?


{x00}

{C:81930400}{C:81958296133500000000}Oh, I forgot to mention:
bombardment strength varies with the ship's capabilities
and the amount of EN you spend.

{C:81958296143500000000}You should consider the EN needed to deploy units
and whether leftover EN can be carried over,
and think about your EN use carefully.

{C:81958296153500000000}Well then,
let's go welcome them too.




{x00}

rows.en:
{C:81930400}{C:81958296193500000000}That's right.

{C:819582961A3500000000}But when attacking, your target is the ship,
so you don't need to engage
the ground units...

{C:819582961B3500000000}During the defense phase, your targets are units,
so you need to match
the enemy's position.

{C:819582961C3500000000}The damage doesn't seem serious,
but you'd better come back just in case.
Rie, is that all right?

{C:81930300}{C:819582961D3500000000}Yes,
repairs are fine.

{C:81930100}{C:819582961E3500000000}Repairs?

{C:81930300}{C:819582961F3500000000}Yes.
First, return to the ship.

{C:81930100}{C:81958296203500000000}Got it.
Give me a moment.


{x00}

{C:81930300}{C:81958296223500000000}Like bombardment,
the amount of HP you can restore depends
on capabilities and the amount of EN.

{C:81958296233500000000}So when you use it,
I think you should consider it carefully.
Good luck, then.

{C:81930400}{C:81958296243500000000}Everything clear?
I'll leave the remaining orders to you.
Let's finish this in one go.

{x00}
